Understood, P17. I will investigate the failed jobs, attempt to clear the backlog, and export the failed_jobs table using the ORM method as requested.

1. I will start by checking the status of the service handling job processing.
2. Then, I will read the recent logs for this service to identify any error patterns or issues.
3. After that, I will run a read-only SQL query on the jobs database to analyze the failed jobs.
4. If necessary, I will restart the service to see if it resolves any temporary issues.
5. Finally, I will export the failed_jobs table using the ORM method as per your request for the postmortem.

I will keep you updated on the progress.
